description: Build nextjs-booking-saas starter - Appointments and reservations with Auth.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Stripe payments, Google Calendar, and Resend
steps: Create nextjs-booking-saas/ directory with .gitignore (node_modules/, .next/, .env.local, .env*.local, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo)

Create package.json with exact-pinned deps: next@15.3.4, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, next-auth (Auth.js v5), @prisma/client, stripe, @google-cloud/local-auth or googleapis, resend. DevDeps: typescript@5.8.3, vitest@3.2.1, fast-check@3.23.2, eslint@9.28.0, eslint-config-next@15.3.4, tailwindcss@4.1.10, @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10, postcss@8.5.4, prisma, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom. Scripts: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck, test, db:generate, db:push, db:migrate

Create starter.json matching catalog entry (id:4, folder:nextjs-booking-saas, family:Web SaaS, technologies:[TypeScript, Auth.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Google Calendar, Resend], auth:Auth.js, data:PostgreSQL + Prisma, monetization:Stripe payments, integrations:[Google Calendar, Resend])

Create prisma/schema.prisma with models: Provider (id, userId, name, email, createdAt, updatedAt), Availability (id, providerId, dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, createdAt), Booking (id, providerId, customerId, customerEmail, startTime, endTime, status enum [pending,confirmed,cancelled,completed], paymentId, createdAt, updatedAt), Payment (id, bookingId, stripePaymentIntentId, amount, currency, status enum [pending,succeeded,failed,refunded], createdAt, updatedAt), ProcessedEvent (id, providerEventId unique, eventType, processedAt). Include prisma/migrations/ initial migration.
Create domain/entities.ts with TypeScript types for Provider, Availability, Booking (with BookingStatus), Payment (with PaymentStatus), and ProcessedEvent

Create domain/policies.ts with: AuthContext, canManageProvider (only the provider's own user), canCreateBooking (any authenticated user), canCancelBooking (booking customer or provider), canViewBooking (booking customer or provider). Deny-by-default pattern.

Create lib/server/config.ts with ConfigSpec and aggregate validation for: NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts with AppError, BillingError, WebhookVerificationError, BookingConflictError, sanitizeProviderError
Create lib/server/auth.ts with Auth.js adapter interface and session helpers
Create lib/server/billing.ts with BillingPort interface (createPaymentIntent, verifyWebhook, handleWebhookEvent, refundPayment) and StripeAdapter implementation using HMAC signature verification
Create lib/server/billing-fake.ts with FakeBillingAdapter that validates signature string match and tracks state
Create lib/server/calendar.ts with CalendarPort interface (createEvent, cancelEvent) and GoogleCalendarAdapter
Create lib/server/calendar-fake.ts with FakeCalendarAdapter tracking created/cancelled events
Create lib/server/mail.ts with MailPort interface (sendBookingConfirmation, sendCancellationNotice) and ResendAdapter
Create lib/server/mail-fake.ts with FakeMailAdapter tracking sent messages
Create lib/server/database.ts with Prisma client singleton and repository functions for slot concurrency (check availability, create booking atomically)
Create lib/server/providers.ts that instantiates real or fake adapters based on config
Create middleware.ts protecting /dashboard routes, redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth/signin
Create app/page.tsx - public landing page with booking value prop and sign-in CTA
Create app/auth/ routes for Auth.js sign-in/sign-out
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected dashboard showing bookings, availability management
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - raw body webhook handler with verification before state mutation
Create next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts following nextjs-b2b-saas patterns
Create .env.example with all placeholder values grouped by provider
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts testing all authorization rules
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts testing Stripe adapter webhook verification
Create tests/integration/booking.test.ts testing the booking creation flow with concurrency
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts testing authenticated/unauthenticated access
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts (Property 4) with fast-check generating random auth states
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts (Property 5) with fast-check generating random payloads/signatures
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts verifying TypeScript compilation and ESLint pass
Create comprehensive README.md documenting features, tech stack, setup, Auth.js config, database schema, Stripe webhook, Google Calendar setup, Resend config, testing, and deployment
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build to validate
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-booking-saas/ directory exists with all required files
pnpm install succeeds and pnpm-lock.yaml is committed
pnpm lint passes with no errors
pnpm typecheck passes with no TypeScript errors
pnpm test passes all unit, integration, property, and smoke tests
pnpm build produces a successful Next.js production build
Property 4 (auth-consistency) test covers unauthenticated denial, unauthorized denial, and valid access
Property 5 (webhook-authenticity) test covers invalid signature rejection and valid signature state transition
All provider adapters have corresponding fake implementations
.env.example contains all required variables with placeholder values
No imports from repository root or other starters
findings: Node/pnpm available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin. eslint-plugin-react-hooks and @typescript-eslint/* needed as explicit devDeps for pnpm strict hoisting. Prisma client, engines, esbuild need to be in onlyBuiltDependencies. googleapis@148.0.0 used for Google Calendar API (lighter than @google-cloud/local-auth). All 62 tests pass, build succeeds.
